# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop prints a QR code on each receipt so customers can leave a review.
  - Mira Example, 2026-10-21: "Someday shops should be able to print a QR code on each receipt so customers can leave a review. Not this release and not soon. I just don't want us to lose the idea."
  - Deferred idea only; no implementation scheduled, and outside this release and near-term plans.
